title: Financial Analyst (FP&A)
must_have_skills: Financial Modelling;Budgeting & Forecasting;Variance Analysis;Advanced Excel;Financial Statement Analysis
description: Own the annual budget and monthly rolling forecast, prepare variance and MIS reports for business heads, build financial models to support pricing and investment decisions, and partner with the leadership team on performance reviews.

title: Investment Banking Analyst
must_have_skills: Financial Modelling;DCF Valuation;Mergers & Acquisitions;Comparable Company Analysis;Pitch Books & CIMs;Advanced Excel
nice_to_have_skills: LBO Modelling;Capital IQ / FactSet / Refinitiv;Bloomberg Terminal;PowerPoint & Reporting;Capital Markets
description: Support live M&A and capital raising mandates: build DCF, LBO and trading comps models, prepare pitch books and information memoranda, conduct industry research and due diligence, and coordinate with clients and legal advisers.

title: Equity Research Analyst
must_have_skills: Equity Research;Fundamental Analysis;Valuation;Financial Modelling;Financial Statement Analysis
nice_to_have_skills: Bloomberg Terminal;Capital IQ / FactSet / Refinitiv;Python;Technical Analysis;Communication;Presentation Skills
description: Cover a basket of listed companies, maintain earnings models, write initiation and update reports with target prices and ratings, and communicate views to institutional clients and the sales desk.

title: Credit Risk Analyst
must_have_skills: Credit Risk;Credit Analysis;Financial Statement Analysis;Ratio Analysis;Risk Management
description: Assess the creditworthiness of corporate borrowers, prepare credit memos and internal ratings, monitor portfolio quality and early-warning signals, run stress tests and ensure adherence to Basel and RBI guidelines.

title: Internal Auditor
description: Plan and execute risk based internal audits, test internal controls (SOX / ICFR), review financial processes and reconciliations, document findings and agree remediation plans with process owners and the audit committee.

title: Portfolio Manager
must_have_skills: Portfolio Management;Asset Management;Fundamental Analysis;Risk Management;Stakeholder Management
description: Manage client and fund portfolios, drive asset allocation and security selection, monitor risk and performance against benchmarks, and present portfolio reviews to clients and the investment committee.

title: Accounting & Compliance Executive
nice_to_have_skills: Tally / QuickBooks;SAP;Taxation;Accounts Payable & Receivable;Advanced Excel;Attention to Detail
description: Handle day-to-day bookkeeping, month-end closing and reconciliations, prepare GST and TDS returns, support statutory audit and ensure financial statements are prepared as per Ind AS.
